decollo.title: A journey through the worlds I've built
decollo.text: Buckle up: scroll and take off with me and my dog for a little tour of the universe. Every planet is a piece of my story.

origini.title: Origins — Salemi, Sicily
origini.text: Raised between the castle of Salemi and a scientific high school: maths, physics and the urge to take things apart to see how they work. Rules are for fools: I explore technology, break it, and rebuild it better.

frontend.title: Planet Frontend
frontend.text: React, Flutter, Tailwind: living, reactive interfaces polished to the pixel. This is where code becomes something people touch.

backend.title: Planet Backend & DevOps
backend.text: Spring Boot, Docker, AWS, CI/CD: the invisible part holding everything up. Containers in orbit and deploys that ship themselves.

competenze.title: Planet Skills
competenze.text: Git, Linux, Figma, Agile: the tools I use every day to build, version and ship. Orbit after orbit, the toolbox grows.

boop.title: Planet BoopStudio
boop.text: My startup: showcase websites, e-commerce and tailor-made apps, from idea to delivery. Every client is a new world to build.

finale.title: A universe of possibilities
finale.text: Every project is a new planet to explore. The next one could be yours: come down to my desk and let's talk.
